changes.after: Add config validate --file as a read-only structural check without setup; bare config remains unported.
changes.rationale: Validate configuration during migration without claiming installation or runtime readiness.

changes.before: Python errors include unversioned error strings and argparse output.
changes.after: Rust errors use schema_version=1 and error.code/error.message, exit 2; help/version remain text.
changes.rationale: Stable machine-readable failures distinguish unavailable operations from valid checks.

changes.before: Python equality admits schema_version=true as equal to 1.
Python config accepts a non-table project field.
changes.after: Require project to be a table when present.
changes.rationale: Reject malformed structure before later consumers attempt to read fields.

changes.before: Path checks depend on the host OS and malformed path types can raise uncaught exceptions.
changes.after: Require string paths with portable relative components; reject backslashes, colons, NUL, absolute paths and parent traversal on all hosts.
changes.rationale: A configuration must not gain escape semantics on a different host.

changes.before: Python permits duplicate target package names.
changes.after: Reject duplicate target packages as well as unknown or unselected names.
changes.rationale: Make package selection unambiguous at every level.

changes.before: Unquoted TOML dates can fail JSON output; nonfinite numbers are not portable JSON values.
changes.after: Reject unquoted dates and nonfinite numbers with structured configuration errors.
changes.rationale: Prevent data coercion or malformed JSON from being mistaken for a successful check.

changes.after: The selected Rust TOML parser also accepts TOML 1.1 syntax; configuration field/type rules still apply.
changes.rationale: Use the maintained Rust parser while making broader syntax acceptance explicit.
